title: The evidence base changes across stations and years
caption: Blank cells: no supplied rows. Zero: no PM2.5 values within supplied rows. No monitoring history is invented.

title: Optional interpolation is a sensitivity layer
caption: Main results use observed values. Random masked gaps do not establish accuracy during real sensor outages.

title: Pollutant distributions are strongly asymmetric
caption: 2017–October 2026. Genuine high concentrations remain; zeros are counted but omitted from logarithmic histograms.

title: Particles co-vary, but size-fraction inconsistencies remain
caption: Seeded sample of at most 180,000 source hours. NOx is ppb; NO2 is µg/m³. Correlation is not a mass balance.

title: Monthly particulate pollution: trend and network coverage
caption: Observed station-month means require ≥75% valid days; daily means require ≥18 hours. Network composition varies.

title: Compare the same ten months, while showing station coverage
caption: Each station needs all ten qualified monthly means. 2017 has no eligible January–October aggregate under this rule.

title: The seasonal cycle dominates particulate variability
caption: Winter: Dec–Feb (Dec assigned to following winter year); summer: Mar–May; monsoon: Jun–Sep; post-monsoon: Oct–Nov.

title: Hourly pollution profiles differ by season
caption: Each source site contributes one hour-season mean. These curves cannot establish local commuting peaks until source clock metadata are verified.

title: Extreme episodes persist across consecutive days
caption: Network means require ≥5 sites/day. Episodes: >150 µg/m³ for ≥3 consecutive calendar days. Missing days break episodes.

title: A limited pollutant subset provides AQI context
caption: Not official overall AQI: excludes CO, O3 and Pb; ≥3 sub-indices including PM; ≥18 hours each. Severe shown as ≥401.

title: Older valid observations remain available
caption: Selected long-history sources only; monthly sufficiency rules unchanged. No source is extended before its observed history.

title: Daily means conceal short-lived high concentrations
caption: Station maxima use observed hours only; variation in within-day measurement coverage affects extreme-value comparisons.

title: Weather–pollution associations depend on context
caption: Co-reported station-day meteorology; unadjusted bins mix seasons and locations. Whiskers show IQR, not confidence intervals.

title: Co-pollutants share patterns; meteorology adds structure
caption: Pairwise-complete station-day data; pair counts exported separately. Dependent records are not independent significance tests.

title: Adjustment changes the interpretation of weather relationships
caption: Left: city daily anomalies, 14-day moving blocks. Right: station-day model, shared 14-day calendar-block clustered intervals.

title: Wind-sector pollution context
caption: Radial scale: median PM2.5 (µg/m³). Wind <0.5 m/s omitted. Pooled stations/seasons; direction does not establish source attribution.

title: Meteorology and model air composition have different histories
caption: Unique field-signature grids weighted equally. Weather: 2017–Oct 2026. AQI: Aug 2022–Oct 2026; no fabricated earlier values.

title: Model values are supplementary estimates, not monitor replacements
caption: Actual valid PM10 overlap begins August 2022. Approximate locations and clock assumptions limit agreement interpretation.

title: The meteorological background spans the full study window
caption: Distributions of unique-grid mean daily model weather, 2017–October 2026; rainfall is a daily total before spatial averaging.

title: Coverage-screened station comparison, 2023–2025
caption: Each site has ≥75% valid days in each year. Dates still differ; these are descriptive monitoring-site means, not intrinsic neighbourhood rankings.

title: Spatial context at supplied approximate locations
caption: Coordinates are user supplied and registry-unverified. Gray points have no coverage-qualified comparison; no pollution surface is interpolated.

title: Regional thermal detections provide broader context
caption: VIIRS detections are not unique fires, burned area or crop-burning labels. Hexagons aggregate detections, not emissions.

title: Fire–pollution comparisons use two observed seasonal windows
caption: Delhi pollution clock assumed IST for this sensitivity. Missing fire dates are not zeros; adjusted lag results are exported separately.

title: Fire associations depend on model controls
caption: Unadjusted HAC7 95% intervals. None of eight expanded regional/northwest tests passes BH p<0.05; two windows cannot establish attribution.

title: Population grids provide exposure context, not personal exposure
caption: Unknown cell footprints and changing positive-value support prevent unqualified population-weighted pollution estimates.

title: Population epochs remain separate from pollution timelines
caption: Points are supplied epochs; connecting lines are guides. All point centres fall within the supplied Delhi boundary.

title: Sector inventories describe emissions structure across available epochs
caption: Selected epochs only; connecting segments are guides. Source units/release unverified; shares are not ambient source contributions.

title: Emission totals and sector shares answer different questions
caption: Indexed totals avoid inventing units. Urban-centre emissions geography (2,139 km²) differs from the supplied Delhi administrative boundary.
